title: UI风格#173 - Medieval Manuscript (中世纪手稿)
description: 创建第173种UI风格：中世纪手稿风格 - 羊皮纸、哥特字体、Illuminated手稿。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planFQ.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Medieval Manuscript style When color palette Then features parchment, burgundy, gold leaf, forest green
Given Medieval Manuscript style When typography Then uses illuminated: Cinzel Decorative, Uncial Antiqua, or MedievalSharp
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Cinzel Decorative (title 2.2rem), Cinzel (headers/buttons), IM Fell English (body italic) - illuminated manuscript typography

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Medieval Manuscript style When layout Then parchment texture, illuminated borders, margin decorations, calligraphic headers
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: parchment texture overlay, double border styling, ornamental flower divider, corner ❧ ornaments, gold accents throughout

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Medieval Manuscript style When UI elements Then quill animations, ink spread, wax seal, gold leaf shimmer
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: gold double borders, gold ornamental symbols, wax seal styling, parchment backgrounds, gold hover effects on buttons

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Medieval Manuscript UI When functional Then includes scroll chat, scribe agents, folio stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Royal Scriptorium chat header, 4 scribe agents (SCRIBE-1, LIBRARIAN, ILLUMINATOR, ROYAL ARCHIVIST) with Folio/Realm/Tome/Scroll/Quill/Ink/Volume/Gold stats

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Medieval Manuscript UI When copy Then uses archaic terms: 'Scroll', 'Scribe', 'Tome', 'Realm'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: title 'SCROLL SCRIBE TOME', tagline 'Where ancient wisdom meets...', button 'INSCRIBE', greeting 'Your Grace, the Royal Scriptorium awaits...', status 'Active'/'Resting', nav '❧ Scroll'/'❧ Commission'/'❧ Inscribe'/'❧ Tome'
